ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FANTASY & PERIOD

STUDY 059
Mint Ribbon Uniform Costume
Rights check
Source: 24401.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
and wispy bangs smiles brightly with her head tilted.
She wears a white and mint ruffled costume with ribbon
ties at the shoulders and waist, a mint cap with white
cross details and lace trim, and a mint choker. Her
hands are clasped near her chest. A pale wood-panel
backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of mint, white,
and soft pink skin. Sweet and playful, in the style of a
cheerful costume-cosplay photo.
Sweet, playful, bright
WORKING NOTES
- The mint ribbons and cap are the signature details.
- Keep the warm, open smile for a friendly tone.
Try this: Keep a warm, open smile.
